title: A cloud run ignores the commit it was submitted at
description:
FOUND 2026-09-22 by the first per-tick Cloudflare smoke run (run_ce54ab2a2f88492aa2b2eeaa23203f2b).

ticfac cloud run pushes the current branch and submits its commit (here 521b4805 on smoke/xte-omp-glm, which carries epic plw). The container boot then runs:

    ticfac run-epic --base "$base_branch" …   (internal/factory/ticfacentrypoint.go:291-294)

with base_branch resolved to the REMOTE'S DEFAULT BRANCH (main). The run is cut from main and its tracker read from main, so the submitted commit is ignored:

    ticfac run-epic plw: reconcile: read the epic graph: … open …/tree/.tick/issues/plw.json: no such file or directory

The Workflow then re-booted the container into the identical failure until the run was stopped by hand.

--base is doing two jobs. It is WHERE THE INTEGRATION BRANCH IS CUT FROM (which must be the submitted commit: that is what the operator submitted) and WHAT IS FOLDED IN ON REFRESH (which should be the default branch, per wvd). The entrypoint chose the second meaning and lost the first. wvd is the same confusion seen from the local side: there --base HEAD cuts correctly and folds nothing.

Also: a deterministic failure like this should not be re-booted. A missing epic on the submitted tree will be missing on every boot.
